label: NAB2::STAT6

sections.text: NAB2 encodes a transcriptional corepressor of EGR-family transcription factors.
STAT6 encodes a transcription factor that transduces interleukin-4/interleukin-13 signals.

The intrachromosomal fusion combines NAB2 EGR-binding sequences with STAT6 activation sequences, converting a transcriptional repressor complex into an activator. It is the defining molecular alteration of solitary fibrous tumor and underlies characteristic nuclear STAT6 staining.
